buildCommand: node scripts/sync-transactions.js && node scripts/update-sw-version.js && next build
ignoreCommand: git log -1 --pretty=%B | grep -qE '\[(skip ci|vercel skip)\]' || { BASE_SHA=HEAD^; if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && [ "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" != "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" ] && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then BASE_SHA="$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA"; fi; git diff --quiet "$BASE_SHA" HEAD ./; }
